categories.main_business_segments: Air China Cargo operates primarily in three business segments: air cargo transportation services, air cargo terminal services, and integrated logistics solutions. The company provides comprehensive air freight services including full freighter and belly cargo operations, cargo terminal handling, warehousing, and contract logistics. It also focuses on cross-border e-commerce logistics and specialized logistics services such as cold chain and high-value goods transportation.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced aviation technologies including a fleet of Boeing 777 and 747 freighters and converted A330 passenger aircraft for cargo operations. It employs digital technologies such as logistics visualization, AI-based security inspection, and the International Air Transport Association's One Record data exchange standard for end-to-end cargo tracking and data integration. The company also invests in sustainable aviation fuel usage and green logistics practices to enhance operational efficiency and environmental performance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include international and domestic manufacturers, cross-border e-commerce platforms, high-value goods shippers (e.g., semiconductors, biopharmaceuticals), and B2B industrial logistics clients such as chemical and automotive parts sectors. The company serves major global trade lanes connecting China with Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific regions, supporting China's manufacturing export and global supply chains.
categories.geographic_coverage: Air China Cargo operates extensively across China with major hubs in Beijing Capital International Airport and Shanghai Pudong International Airport. Its international network covers 21 cities in 12 countries, including key destinations in the US, Europe (Germany, Netherlands, France, Spain, Belgium, Italy), Japan, and emerging markets along the Belt and Road Initiative. The company also maintains cargo terminals and partnerships in multiple domestic and overseas locations to support its logistics network.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the air cargo supply chain as an air freight carrier and logistics service provider. It controls cargo aircraft operations, cargo terminal handling, and integrated logistics services, linking upstream manufacturers and downstream distributors and retailers. It also engages in supply chain integration through contract logistics and cross-border e-commerce fulfillment.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding air cargo capacity and network coverage, enhancing digital transformation and smart logistics capabilities, and advancing green aviation initiatives aligned with China's dual carbon goals. R&D focuses on developing sales bidding systems, logistics data governance, and implementing IATA's One Record standard for data interoperability. The company also invests in AI applications for security and operational efficiency and collaborates with academic and industry partners on fuel efficiency and supply chain innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through air cargo transportation fees from full freighter and belly cargo services, cargo terminal handling charges, and fees for integrated logistics and contract logistics solutions. Additional income streams include leasing services and other ancillary logistics services. The company operates on a service fee and contract basis, with long-term agreements with major customers and dynamic pricing models including bidding systems.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Air China Cargo is one of the leading air cargo carriers in China and the only national flag carrier dedicated to cargo logistics under the China Aviation Group. It holds a significant market share of 9.19% in China's international air cargo market as of 2024. Competitors include other major Chinese and international cargo airlines, express delivery companies, and logistics providers. The company differentiates itself through its extensive network, fleet modernization, strategic partnerships, and strong government backing.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 20.58 billion, a 37.97% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.95 billion, up 69.34%. Total assets reached RMB 27.62 billion, growing 21.01% from the previous year. The company has shown strong growth driven by expanded capacity, network optimization, and increased demand in cross-border e-commerce and high-value cargo segments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Air China Cargo emphasizes its unique position as the national flag cargo airline with a strong brand and government support, offering reliable, safe, and high-quality air freight services. Its value proposition includes comprehensive global network coverage, advanced fleet and cargo handling capabilities, digital and smart logistics solutions, and specialized services for high-value and time-sensitive goods. The company also highlights its commitment to green logistics and innovation as key differentiators.
